description: Lets Manhattin send email as your domain (DKIM signature and bounce-handling subdomain). Optional groups add a reply subdomain and a starter DMARC record. Your existing mailbox (root MX) is never changed.
variableDescription: %dkimSelector%: DKIM selector given by Manhattin (e.g. resend); %dkimPublicKey%: DKIM public key, base64, without p=; %returnPathTarget%: host the send subdomain points to (bounce handling and SPF); %sesRegion%: AWS region of the legacy return path (e.g. us-east-1); %replyMxHost%: inbound mail host for the reply subdomain; %dmarcPolicy%: none, quarantine or reject
